decisions.reason: As a close-to-core service offer with moderate carrying cost, we would keep it for now, but its lower visibility and overlap with other express options raise the chance of later withdrawal.

The seventy-two-hour program appears operationally costly to maintain and overlaps with other fast-delivery offers, so if early results are not clearly strong the option value is likely too low to justify continuation.
This certified fire-resistant exterior door fits the firm's core safety-focused range, uses existing technical capabilities, and still has meaningful upside under ongoing market uncertainty.
A broader express program for doors and gates supports the firm's one-stop-service positioning and merits continuation while demand and profitability across customer segments become clearer.

The digital ordering and service platform is strategically aligned with deeper advisory and service support, and once developed its incremental carrying cost is relatively low compared with its option value.
The fire and smoke protection door is tightly aligned with the firm's compliance and safety strengths, so despite modest visibility it is worth keeping while commercial traction continues to develop.
